info.title: КАТЕКС Toolstock API
info.description: C++20 / PostgreSQL. Cookie + CSRF for browser clients, or Bearer token from auth/login. All authenticated writes require a unique Idempotency-Key; reuse the same key and payload for network retries. Bootstrap is available only before the first administrator. Closing a purchase never creates stock movements.
